svg.title: P5 · Health, metrics and the public status page
svg.desc: Gatus polls readiness directly on the internal network; Traefik checks readiness before routing; Prometheus scrapes metrics; Grafana is the operator view (ADR-004, ADR-012).
svg.text: P5 · Health, metrics and the public status page
Gatus polls readiness directly on the internal network; Traefik checks readiness before routing; Prometheus scrapes metrics; Grafana is the operator view (ADR-004, ADR-012).

g.text: Readiness covers the own database, not the broker
Rolled up into capabilities, never named publicly
Grafana access in demo is open
